item.title: BTS, Cardi B, LE SSERAFIM & More Set for iHeartRadio Music Festival: See the Lineup
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update! If you're a fan of live music and star-studded lineups, you won't want to miss this. The 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival is just around the corner, and we've got the scoop on the performers and how to get tickets.
[Music transitions to a lively background tune]
Host: "The festival is set to take place on September 18 and 19 at the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas. And what a lineup it is! You can expect to see acts like BTS, Cardi B, Lainey Wilson, Benson Boone, Zara Larsson, and many more. The list just keeps going - Goo Goo Dolls, Kenny Chesney, Major Lazer, Muse, Snoop Dogg, and Weezer are all on board. And just announced, K-pop girl group LE SSERAFIM has been added to the mix!
[Music continues to play in the background]
Host: "According to Tom Poleman and John Sykes, the chief programming officer and president of entertainment enterprises, this year's lineup is all about bringing together the biggest artists across every genre for two unforgettable nights. And with Ryan Seacrest hosting, you know it's going to be a wild ride.
[Music transitions to a quicker pace]
Host: "So, how can you get in on the action? Tickets go on sale to the public on June 12, but if you're a Capital One cardholder, you can get access to an exclusive presale starting June 10. And if you can't make it to Vegas, don't worry - you can stream the performances on Disney+ and Hulu.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's it for today's music update. The 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival is shaping up to be an unforgettable event. Mark your calendars for September 18 and 19, and get ready for two nights of non-stop music and excitement. We'll see you there!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
